description:
Will this product work before I manufacture it? (¿Funcionará este producto antes de fabricarlo?)

Evaluates a product before manufacturing it: Wintraits Match Index (similarity to winners, 0-100) from its attributes (assuming
a complete listing), the changes that raise it most, the traps it has and the winning gaps it could fill.

Args:
    precio_eur: planned selling price in euros.
    atributos: attribute -> value (a list for list-type attributes). Valid values in wintraits_opciones_concepto,
        e.g. {"ingredientes_clave": ["niacinamida"], "textura": "gel", "promesa_cuantificada": true}.
    volumen_ml: container volume in ml.
    descripcion: free description of the concept (optional).
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en" (attribute names in English).

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_evaluar_concepto
